name: kilimcininkoroglu-mods
description: Claude Mods (function-hooks plugins) for Claude Code.

plugins.name: task-poke
plugins.description: Submits a continue prompt while the task list has unfinished tasks, at most 99 times in a row by default, and turns the task tools on for every model unless CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS is set.

plugins.name: limit-watch
plugins.description: Shows the subscription usage limits under the prompt or in the shared sidebar with a reset countdown and a projection, opens a /limit-watch pane, logs once when a limit passes 80% and 95%, and stops sampling entirely with /limit-watch off.

plugins.name: memory-save
plugins.description: Loads MEMORY.md into the session and saves project learnings to it after every turn through a tool-less fork in the background, without blocking the stop.

plugins.name: cache-warm
plugins.description: Keeps the 1-hour prompt cache warm for a window you set, or with no end in every session under always, with one cache-shared fork per idle stretch and one keep-warm message after a resume, arms a window for you after a paid cold write, and shows the cache state, the cold price and this session's cold writes.

plugins.name: prompt-time
plugins.description: Draws the time under each of your messages and each text block of the model's replies, also for a resumed session whose transcript is 4 MiB or smaller. Display only: nothing reaches the model.

plugins.name: gemini-compact
plugins.description: Moves compaction from Claude to Gemini: in summary mode Gemini summarizes the conversation and the newest messages stay verbatim, in prune mode every message stays and Gemini keeps, cuts or drops older tool calls. Off until /gemini-compact on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

plugins.name: gemini-advisor
plugins.description: Gives the model a Gemini advisor tool it calls by itself: Gemini reads the whole conversation and the model's message and answers with a second opinion. Off until /gemini-advisor on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

plugins.name: gemini-review
plugins.description: Has Gemini review every git commit the model runs, from the staged diff and the conversation, and stops a commit with a blocking finding: a bug, data loss, a security hole or a committed secret. Off until /gemini-review on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

plugins.name: gemini-core
plugins.description: Keeps the Gemini keys and tier of every Gemini mod, and each mod's model and thinking level, in one place: adds $.gemini, which builds their Gemini requests, reads the answers and moves to the next key after a quota or key error, and picks a model from Google's list.

plugins.name: flaky-memory
plugins.description: Remembers which tests failed on which code, and tells the model when a failing test has both passed and failed on the same code, so it runs the test again instead of changing code.

plugins.name: gemini-plan-review
plugins.description: Has Gemini review each plan before the approval dialog, from the plan and the conversation, and sends a plan with a blocking finding back to the model, at most twice. Off until /gemini-plan-review on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

plugins.name: disk-janitor
plugins.description: Measures the build artifacts of the repository, shows them on the status line from 5 GB, and deletes the ones you pick in the /disk-janitor pane; data directories are never listed.

plugins.name: contract-watch
plugins.description: After the model changes a function signature with Edit, adds the callers ripwire finds to the Edit's result, so the model fixes them before the build does.

plugins.name: doc-drift-watch
plugins.description: After each commit the model makes, adds the doc lines that commit made stale (file:line references, symbol names) to the commit's result, from ripwire doc-drift, and holds each finding open until the doc holds again.

plugins.name: prompt-deck
plugins.description: Learns the short prompts you send often in this project and draws them, with the ones you pin by hand, above the prompt; with the prompt box empty, a digit key sends one at once.

plugins.name: shot-inline
plugins.description: Draws each PNG or JPG the model saves or reads under its tool row: pixels in kitty and Ghostty, quadrant block cells in every other terminal.

plugins.name: diagram-render
plugins.description: Renders the mermaid blocks of the model's replies with an installed mmdc after each turn and draws each picture under its reply.

plugins.name: dep-sentinel
plugins.description: Checks each package the model installs against its registry and OSV.dev, and stops a missing, brand-new, look-alike, outdated or vulnerable one, naming the latest version.

plugins.name: edit-loop
plugins.description: Adds a note to the fifth edit of one file in one turn, so the model re-reads the code path and states the root cause instead of trying again.

plugins.name: i18n-watch
plugins.description: After an edit that calls translation keys, names the keys the JSON, Laravel PHP, YAML or gettext locale files lack, and the languages that lack them.

plugins.name: env-sync
plugins.description: After each commit the model makes, names the env variables its added lines read that .env.example lacks, with the file and line of each.

plugins.name: sql-concat-watch
plugins.description: After an edit that builds SQL by joining or interpolating strings, names each line, so the model passes the values as query parameters.

plugins.name: lockfile-sync
plugins.description: After each commit the model makes, names the manifests whose dependencies it changed without their lockfile (npm, Composer, Cargo, Go, Python, Bundler, Dart, Mix).

plugins.name: bg-tasks
plugins.description: Shows the background shell tasks of the session on the status line or in the shared sidebar, with the oldest one's age, and stops one from the /bg-tasks pane.

plugins.name: action-pin
plugins.description: After an edit that adds a GitHub Actions step pinned to a tag or a branch, names the commit SHA to write instead, from the GitHub API.

plugins.name: sidebar
plugins.description: Opens one shared pane beside the transcript and draws the sections, lines and buttons every other mod writes into it through $.sidebar; each stream entry is stamped with its time and kept in a per-project log the next session takes back.

plugins.name: prompt-offload
plugins.description: Writes a prompt longer than the limit (2000 characters by default) to a temp file and sends the model its first 200 characters with the path, so one paste does not fill the context.

plugins.name: config-parse
plugins.description: Parses each JSON, YAML, TOML or .env file an Edit or Write touches, notes a parse error at once instead of at the next build, and says so again when a later edit fixes it.

plugins.name: error-poke
plugins.description: Sends one continue prompt after a turn an API error killed, so the half-done work carries on instead of the session going idle, at most 99 times in a row by default.

plugins.name: output-flood
plugins.description: Measures how much context each Bash command spent and tells the model, past a size limit, which narrower command would have answered the same question.

plugins.name: ua-fallback
plugins.description: After a curl or wget an automated-client filter answered 403 or 429, gives the model the browser User-Agent to retry with, and the two cases where it must not.

plugins.name: subagent-ledger
plugins.description: Shows each subagent of the session with its turns, time, model and tokens, the costliest first, yellow while it runs and green once it answered, and marks one that passed the token limit.

plugins.name: mod-doctor
plugins.description: Names each installed plugin, of every marketplace, whose local clone already offers a newer version, with the claude plugin update command that closes the gap.

plugins.name: commit-cadence
plugins.description: Names the uncommitted files to you at the end of each turn, and tells the model at the next prompt to commit each finished piece as it lands.

plugins.name: storage-guard
plugins.description: After an edit that keeps browser data in localStorage or sessionStorage, names each line, so the model stores the data in a cookie instead.

plugins.name: context-restore
plugins.description: Hands a skill or command call the current text of its file when the file changed on disk after the session loaded it, and hands the model a rules file or the global CLAUDE.md that changed on disk.

plugins.name: mcp-doctor
plugins.description: Tells you when an MCP server failed to connect or dropped, with the engine's reason and a reconnect button, and when it is back; claude.ai connectors are left out.

plugins.name: orphan-server
plugins.description: Lists the servers a Bash call of the model started in this repository and left listening on a port, with their age and session, and stops one with SIGTERM, then SIGKILL.

plugins.name: slash-chain
plugins.description: Runs slash commands joined with && one after another, waits for each command's turn, pane or dialog to end, and stops the chain at a command that failed or a turn that ended without an answer.

plugins.name: desk-notify
plugins.description: Sends a desktop notification when a question or a plan waits for your answer, and when a turn ends or fails.

plugins.name: ask-autopick
plugins.description: Picks the recommended option of a question that waited unanswered for a set time, so a session you left does not stop. Off until you turn it on.

plugins.name: bash-diet
plugins.description: Shrinks each Bash result before the model reads it: per-command filters for git, test runners, linters, package managers, containers and file tools, the full output kept in a file.

plugins.name: session-watch
plugins.description: Shows this session's state in the sidebar: context fill, token totals, cost, model and effort, the Claude Code version, the other sessions of this machine, and the git branch and status.

plugins.name: idle-art
plugins.description: Draws an ASCII animation above the prompt while the model works: matrix rain, fire, an aquarium, a cat, or a GIF of your own imported as a character clip for every project. Display only: nothing reaches the model.

plugins.name: tool-coach
plugins.description: Stops the model from repeating a tool call that just failed with the same input, until a file or command has changed something.

plugins.name: effort-auto
plugins.description: Has a small model rate how hard each prompt is and runs that turn and its subagents at the matching effort, within the levels you allow, on the models whose prompt cache survives an effort change.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Asks a council of models about a hard problem, when the model calls its tool or you run /council <question>: Claude models, and Gemini models when gemini-core has a key, answer in parallel, and the model of the session writes one verdict from their answers.

plugins.name: pin-note
plugins.description: Keeps the notes you pin with /pin-note for the whole session and sends them to the model again, word for word, after each compaction and /clear. Off until /pin-note on.

plugins.name: sage-memory
plugins.description: Keeps project and global memories in SQLite through a shared local daemon, hands the model the entries that match its file tool calls, prompts and subagent tasks, and saves new ones with a haiku consolidator after each main-loop turn.

plugins.name: probe-runner
plugins.description: For mod development: runs a live check of plugins in a fresh Claude Code session in tmux, types the steps one by one, collects the pane and the transcript, then deletes the temp directory, its transcripts and the inline store files.

plugins.name: self-command
plugins.description: For mod development: lets the model run a slash command in its own session, such as /reload-plugins after a plugin update, and read the output as the next prompt.

plugins.name: git-commit
plugins.description: Ships a commit skill and holds every Bash git commit to it: a commit the skill did not open, a blanket git add, a signature trailer, a secret, an ignored path, or a push or branch change nobody asked for is stopped before git runs.

plugins.name: bughunt
plugins.description: Runs proof-driven bug hunt rounds with /bughunt: each round proves one bug with a failing command the mod runs itself, fixes it, and proves the fix, and the loop stops on a blocked or unverified round. /bughunt collab runs a read-only scanner, planner and critic in sequence.
